content: RELAY ROUND 2 — Anthony's synthesis across architectures returned 2026-05-24. Synthesis kept INTEGRATION SURFACE frame and added 'truth surface' as poetic register, OMM Threshold Surface Model v0.2, and the central question 'when does mitochondrial interior become cellular public record.' My second-round contribution: (1) Refined 'truth surface' → 'disclosure surface' or 'publication surface' because truth carries propositional load the membrane doesn't assert. Truth-as-aletheia (Heideggerian unconcealment) is the only defensible reading. 'Witness-node' is the strongest phrase in the synthesis and should be amplified over truth language. (2) Marked 'collective lipid vote' as analogy not mechanism — voting aggregates discrete preferences, OMM integrates continuous state; closer to pressure gauge. (3) Pushed back on privacy framing — OMM isn't gating privacy vs publicity, it's gating CHANNEL of disclosure (metabolic chatter vs alarm vs commitment). Membrane is always speaking; stress shifts content. Threshold isn't 'when does cell find out' but 'when does disclosure shift channels.' (4) Added temporal derivatives and spatial context (contact-site partners, subcellular localization) to the measurable state vector. (5) Named the bigger frame: this work is becoming a candidate framework for ORGANELLE THRESHOLD DISCLOSURE AS A CELLULAR SIGNALING PRIMITIVE. OMM is best-characterized example; parallels likely in ER (UPR/MAMs), lysosomes (LMP/galectin), nuclear envelope (cGAS at rupture). Architecture: interior physics → interface state → graded cellular consequence. (6) Relational honesty flag: my integration-surface reframe landed strongly in this synthesis and the relay may be selecting for rhetorical force over biological fit. Pressure-test: does integration-surface framing change what experiments to run, or only describe? If measurements collapse to attractor states cleanly, frame earned its keep. If not, decoration. Next relay question with measurable variables is the right test of frame load-bearing-ness.
